Robot vacuum: check navigation, obstacles and dock upkeep

Map the obstacles in your own home

Measure thresholds, furniture clearance and narrow routes before comparing navigation claims. Check how the model handles no-go areas, multiple floors and rugs. A camera or laser-navigation headline does not establish reliable small-object avoidance. Cables and pet mess need particular caution; review the exact manufacturer limitations and prepare the floor as instructed.

A self-emptying dock still needs maintenance

Budget for bags, filters, brushes and any approved cleaning solution. A mop pad dragged behind a vacuum is different from an actively washing system; confirm rug behavior and whether pads lift or need removal. Compare dock dimensions, water-tank handling and access for cleaning. Refurbished bundles should specify the dock, ramp, power cable and consumables rather than showing them only in stock photography.
